Name: Cute Forest Farm
Author: EllieBellaLuna
Description:
[center][size=6]Cute Forest Farm[/size]

[size=3]Cute Forest Farm is a new farm type you can choose when starting a new save.

[/size][size=3]This creates a new farm map type (Cute Forest Farm) and can optionally replace an existing farm map type so that you can use this map without monsters spawning.[/size]

[b]Known bugs:[/b][/size]

[b]Monsters are spawning[/b]
In order to use this map without monsters spawning, change the "replaceFarm" value to something other than "Wilderness" or "false".

[b]TV[/b]
It does not work and/or opens up the dresser menu. To fix this, install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12717]Fix TVs On Custom Farms[/url] mod.

[b]Dresser[/b]
Same issue as above, but it does seem to work once you pick it up and place it back down.
